step: align the mobile proposal controls with the governed draft to approval to sent lifecycle without changing approved preview geometry

behavior_before_repair: The Send Proposal control always inserted a new pending approval, including when the proposal was already approved.
An approved proposal could therefore fail instead of transitioning through the governed approved to sent path.
The Save Draft control remained active for approved and externally progressed proposals even though database governance rejects those regressions.

application_commits.message: fix(proposals): align mobile send action with lifecycle
test(governance): pin mobile proposal lifecycle actions

controls: Draft proposals request one governed approval.
Internal-review proposals expose a disabled Approval Pending action rather than creating duplicate requests.
Approved proposals transition to sent through bidfast_proposals so the database role, approval, timestamp, and audit triggers remain authoritative.
Sent, viewed, signed, declined, and expired proposals cannot invoke another send write.
Save Draft is disabled after approval or external progression.
The preview sample remains approved, retaining the approved Send Proposal label and component geometry.
governance_guards_added: Require status-aware request and send branches.
Reject reintroduction of the obsolete requestSendApproval click handler.

remaining_blockers: The new BIDFAST preview deployment has not completed.
The preview has not passed exact governed Supabase provenance for mhaovpyegtysfgualplu.
Governed Supabase contains zero public.bidfast_* tables and functions and no takeoff-documents bucket.
The proposal lifecycle repair cannot be transaction-tested against tenant-isolation and authorization-bypass cases until an isolated BIDFAST schema exists.
No approved route reaches measured visual parity 0.99 and complete approved light/dark multi-viewport coverage remains incomplete.
